notes.title: Small Living World 2 announcement!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce our new project : Small Living World 2 🌍, scheduled to be released in summer 2026! 


In development for almost 2 years now, we have rebuilt the game from the ground up. The visual was entirely redrawn, and many news features were added.



You can see the list of all what's new on the Small Living World 2 Steam page.



If you are a fan of the first game, please send us an email. We have free keys 🔑 for a limited selection of beta testers.



📅 Coming to Steam in 2026 — Wishlist now to stay updated!

notes.title: Patch 1.8.2
notes.content:
Version 1.8.2

- The game will now stay AWAKE when it lost the focus. So you can let it runs in the background while you do other things. This make sense for this kind of game.
- The game will still SLEEP if the window is MINIMIZE ( in the task bar ).
- Sandbox will be available if one sandbox save game already exist.

notes.title: Small Living World Now Available
notes.content:
After a short beta and a demo without any issue, it is time to fully release the game.
Hurray !!!
Get it now to benefit the 25% rebate.

One feedback was raised. The game goes into pause when the app doesn't have the focus. Yes, it should continue to run in background, I agree. I will fix this behavior shortly. Check for the update.

notes.title: Small Living World Demo available NOW.
notes.content:
The demo is now available! 

And, it is ahead of schedule ːsteamhappyː .
A rare thing those days.

You can download it and try the game for free.

The demo contains some limitations that aren't present in the full game.

I'm still planning the full game release this summer.
In fact, the game is mostly done, I'm just waiting for feedbacks.
